meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分类和验证 issue 与 PR，生成 agent 可用简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要手动分类和验证 GitHub issue 与外部 PR
copy.tagline_en: Automatically categorize and verify issues and PRs, generate agent-ready briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often manually categorize and verify GitHub issues and external PRs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你对 GitHub 议题和外部 PR 进行分类、验证、追问，并生成供 AI 代理执行的简要说明。它会按状态机推进议题：先分类（bug 或 enhancement），再分配状态（如 needs-triage、ready-for-agent 等），最后应用结果。
howto.when: 当维护者在议题或 PR 上输入 /triage 并描述需求时触发。例如说“看看 #42”或“把 #42 移到 ready-for-agent”。

say.note: Claude 会读取议题内容并给出分类和状态建议。

say.text: 显示所有需要我关注的议题
say.note: Claude 会列出未分类、待评估和等待回复的议题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can categorize, verify, grill, and write agent-ready briefs for GitHub issues and external PRs. It moves them through a state machine: first assign a category (bug or enhancement), then a state (e.g., needs-triage, ready-for-agent), and apply the outcome.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a maintainer types /triage on an issue or PR and describes what they want, e.g., "Look at #42" or "Move #42 to ready-for-agent".

say_en.note: Claude reads the issue and recommends category and state.
Claude applies the state directly and asks if an agent brief is needed.

say_en.text: Show me everything that needs my attention.
say_en.note: Claude lists untriaged, needs-triage, and needs-info items.
